customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, working well, and appreciate its budget-friendly nature and premium appearance. The water quality receives positive feedback, with tests showing it is clean and pure, and customers like the taste. The service and customer experience receive mixed reviews, with some reporting prompt service while others describe very bad service and frustrating experiences.

reviews.author: Balajee Bhardwaj
reviews.title: Good performance and great water taste
reviews.body: Good water purifier that gets the job done. The filtration works great—it brought down the TDS effectively, and the water tastes fresh and clean with no chemical odor. The build quality is compact and fits nicely in the kitchen without taking up too much space. Water wastage is also relatively lower compared to standard RO models. Deducting one star only because the dispensing flow could be slightly faster and installation took a couple of days to schedule. Overall, reliable value for money.

reviews.author: John Çherian
reviews.title: Aquaguard delight s/steel water purifier
reviews.body: This is another awesome water purifier from Eureka Forbes. Used another model for the past 13 years and now replaced with this new model with a stainless steel collection tank fitted inside. Got a good offer from Amazon during their recent Freedom sale. Eureka Forbes installation team did an excellent job as expected and they dismantled the old purifier with the new purifier. Only regret is that there was a buy back offer from Eureka Forbes for the old one which we were using and we couldn't avail this offer due to very bad misguiding aptitude from Amazon customer care. reviews.author: Surendra
reviews.title: Water
reviews.body: The product was really good overall. However, I noticed that the water taste is slightly different compared to the water from a regular water filter. Because of this, I felt the taste was not quite up to the mark. Apart from that, the product is working really well and is in good condition.
